$comment: This repository has no published URL yet, so a config's $schema is the repository-relative path schemas/v2/config/inputs.json; the loader checks that suffix and never dereferences it. Give this file an absolute $id when the repository has a public home.
title: The survey microdata and the population to draw from it

name.description: The CSV file, relative to the config.

columns.description: Column name to declared type. Columns are matched case-insensitively and appear in the loaded table in the order declared here.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3, e.g. FRA.

size_fraction.description: The fraction of the real population to simulate.
